title: Introduction to MS-Paint
parentNote: If MS Paint (or any simple drawing app) is available, let your child actually try the Pencil, Fill, and Eraser tools before this unit — feeling the difference between them makes these questions much easier.
learnBullets: What MS Paint is used for
The main tools: **Pencil, Brush, Eraser, Fill with colour, Shapes, Text**
How to pick colours and fix mistakes with **Undo**
learnItFirst:
**MS Paint** is a program used to draw and colour pictures on a computer.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| ✏️ Pencil | Draws thin, freehand lines |
| 🖌️ Brush | Draws thicker, textured strokes |
| 🧽 Eraser | Removes part of a drawing |
| 🪣 Fill with colour | Fills a whole closed area with one colour |
| ⬛ Shapes | Draws neat shapes — rectangle, circle, line |
| 🔤 Text | Types words onto the picture |
| 🎨 Colour palette | Where you pick your drawing colour |

**Fixing mistakes:** Click **Undo** to take back your last action. Always **Save** your picture when you're done, so you can open it again later.

**Watch out:** The Fill tool colours a WHOLE closed area. If the outline has a gap, the colour can "leak" out and colour more than you wanted!

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Picture** what you want to do — draw a thin line? Colour a big area? Fix a mistake?
2. **Match** it to the ONE tool built for exactly that job.
3. **Remember**: a closed shape with no gaps is needed for Fill to work properly.

questions.content: MS Paint is a program used to:
questions.why: MS Paint is a drawing program

questions.content: Which tool do we use to draw a thin line freehand in MS Paint?
questions.why: The Pencil draws thin freehand lines

questions.content: Which tool do we use to remove or erase part of our drawing?
questions.why: The Eraser removes part of a drawing

questions.content: Which tool fills a closed shape with colour all at once?
questions.why: Fill colours a whole closed area at once

questions.content: Where do we pick the colour we want to draw with?
questions.why: The colour palette is where we pick our drawing colour

questions.content: Which tool lets us type WORDS onto our picture?
questions.why: The Text tool types words onto the picture

questions.content: Which tool would you use to draw a THICK, textured line?
questions.why: The Brush draws thicker, textured lines

questions.content: To draw a straight rectangle or circle easily, which tool would you use?
questions.why: The Shapes tool draws neat rectangles, circles, and more

questions.content: If you make a mistake in MS Paint, which action can undo it?
questions.why: Undo takes back the last action

questions.content: To keep our finished picture so we can open it again later, we should:
questions.why: Saving keeps the picture so it can be opened again later

questions.content: Riya wants to colour a big area of her drawing QUICKLY with one colour. Which tool should she use?
questions.why: Fill colours a big area quickly

questions.content: Which MS Paint tool is best for drawing a perfect circle or square?
questions.why: The Shapes tool draws neat, perfect shapes

questions.content: Rohan wants to write his name on his drawing. Which tool should he pick?
questions.why: The Text tool is used to write words

questions.content: Which of these tools would you use FIRST to remove a mistake before drawing again?
questions.why: The Eraser removes a mistake before you draw again

questions.content: Which tool draws thin, freehand lines — good for fine details?
questions.why: The Pencil is best for thin, fine details

questions.content: Which tool draws thicker, more textured strokes — good for painting big areas by hand?
questions.why: The Brush is best for painting big areas with texture

questions.content: To choose a NEW colour before drawing, which part of MS Paint do you click on?
questions.why: This is where new colours are chosen

questions.content: Which of these is NOT a drawing tool in MS Paint?
questions.why: A speaker is not a drawing tool in MS Paint

questions.content: If you draw a wrong line, what is the FASTEST way to fix just that one mistake?
questions.why: Undo quickly fixes the last mistake only

questions.content: Which tool would you use to draw a STRAIGHT line neatly?
questions.why: The Line tool draws neat, straight lines

questions.content: Meera fills a heart shape with red colour using the Fill tool, but the WHOLE picture turns red instead. What most likely went wrong?

options.C: Red is not a real colour
options.D: The heart shape had a gap, so the colour leaked out

questions.why: Fill spreads through any gap in the outline

questions.content: Which tool would help you select and move just ONE part of your drawing to another place?
questions.why: The Selection tool lets you pick and move part of a drawing

questions.content: Before you start drawing in MS Paint, what should you usually pick first?

options.D: A colour from the colour palette

questions.why: Picking a colour usually comes before drawing

questions.content: Which of these would you use to draw a picture of the sun as a circle with straight-line rays?

options.B: Shapes tool AND Line tool together

questions.why: A circle needs Shapes; straight rays need the Line tool

questions.content: What happens when you use the Eraser tool over part of your drawing?

options.A: That part gets a new colour

questions.why: The Eraser clears whatever it passes over

questions.content: Rohan wants to draw a rainbow with 3 different coloured stripes. Which TWO tools would help him MOST?

options.D: Shapes/Pencil (to draw the stripes) AND Fill with colour (to colour each one)

questions.why: Drawing tools make the stripes; Fill adds the colour

questions.content: Sam drew a nice picture but accidentally clicked Undo 3 times. What is the BEST way to get his last 3 actions back?
questions.why: Redo brings back actions that were undone

questions.content: Which of these correctly matches a Paint tool to its use?

options.C: Fill with colour — colours a whole closed area at once

questions.why: This is the correct match

questions.content: Priya wants her heart-shaped drawing to fill properly with pink colour without leaking. What should she check BEFORE using the Fill tool?

options.A: That she uses the Eraser first
options.B: That the computer is switched off
options.C: That she saved the file first
options.D: That the heart's outline has no gaps or breaks

questions.why: A closed outline stops the colour from leaking

questions.content: Which is the correct ORDER of steps to draw and save a simple picture in MS Paint?

options.A: Pick a colour → Draw with a tool → Save the picture
options.B: Draw → Turn off the computer without saving
options.D: Save the picture → Pick a colour → Draw

questions.why: This is the correct order of steps
